description:
Create a Gantt chart in Wondershare EdrawMax for a database migration project. 

1. From the Home screen, navigate to the 'Project Management' category and create a new 'Gantt Chart'.
2. Set the diagram title to 'Oracle to PostgreSQL Migration'.
3. Enter the following 6 project phases into the Gantt chart data table (Task Name, Start, Finish/Duration):
   - Phase 1: Assessment & Planning (Duration: 2 weeks, Start: Week 1)
   - Phase 2: Schema Conversion (Duration: 3 weeks, Start: Week 3)
   - Phase 3: ETL Development (Duration: 4 weeks, Start: Week 4)
   - Phase 4: Data Migration (Duration: 3 weeks, Start: Week 8)
   - Phase 5: UAT Testing (Duration: 3 weeks, Start: Week 10)
   - Phase 6: Go-Live & Support (Duration: 2 weeks, Start: Week 13)

4. Save the diagram as 'migration_gantt.eddx' in /home/ga/.
5. Export the diagram as a PNG image named 'migration_gantt.png' in /home/ga/ using File > Export > Graphics > PNG.
